verdict.rationale: Appwrite explicitly advertises self-hosting as giving 'full control over data location' (appwrite-docs-24) and documents that it can run on any Docker-capable infrastructure anywhere (appwrite-docs-14/19/33/34), which lets an AI-native user pick their own region/residency by choosing where to deploy. However, there's no evidence of a native region-selection feature within Appwrite Cloud itself (e.g., a dropdown to pick data center region for the hosted SaaS), so users on the managed cloud service have no documented residency choice. Missing for 10: cloud-hosted region/residency selection UI, explicit list of supported regions/data centers, and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments achieving compliance-grade residency.
